articles.summary: PHINIA Inc. (NYSE: PHIN), a diversified industrial supplier and global leader in the development of fuel systems, electrical systems, and aftermarket solutions, has completed the acquisition of 100% of the equity interests of the stoba Group, a global technology partner specialized in high-precision components, systems, and customized manufacturing solutions. articles.title: PHINIA Completes Strategic Acquisition of the stoba Group
